<div class="language-switch">**English** | [한글](research-ko.qmd)</div>

Academic papers are necessarily compact and specialized. Important engineering ideas can therefore be difficult to see behind the equations, methodology, and technical details.

**Research Explained** revisits published research and ongoing research directions from a broader perspective: the engineering problem, the underlying physical or conceptual idea, the method used to address it, and what the results mean in practice.

The articles are organized around four research directions.

## Offshore Wind Energy

Fixed and floating offshore wind substructures, structural response, motion control, transportation and installation, new structural concepts, and engineering decision-making for offshore wind.

[Explore this research area →](research/offshore-wind-energy.qmd)

::: {#offshore}
:::

## Digital Transformation & AI

Digital construction standards, machine-readable engineering knowledge, ontology, automatic compliance checking, BIM-linked applications, digital engineering examples, and AI-assisted engineering.

[Explore this research area →](research/digital-transformation-ai.qmd)

::: {#digital}
:::

## Concrete & Materials

Concrete durability, coupled deterioration, reactive particles, industrial by-products, sustainable materials, and the mechanics connecting microstructure to engineering performance.

[Explore this research area →](research/concrete-materials.qmd)

::: {#concrete}
:::

## Computational Mechanics & Fracture

XFEM, XEFG, multiple cracks, alternative crack representations, multiscale fracture, and the broader lessons of enriched computational mechanics.

[Explore this research area →](research/computational-mechanics-fracture.qmd)

::: {#computational}
:::
